name: Onbara Ren
source:
[url=/c82262]Ai's[/url] younger sister. Ren's route will only be playable after finishing the other heroines' routes.

Her color bell is the Sakura color bell. [spoiler]Later her mother gives her a love color bell which is pink color but it does not have any powers[/spoiler].
